diagnosis.root_cause: An overnight load-balancer configuration change caused most instances to be marked unhealthy, removing them from rotation and overloading the remaining instances.
evidence: A load-balancer config change went in overnight.
app-lb / lb_healthy_instances dropped by 75.3% around 03:04 UTC.
app-lb / http_5xx_rate spiked significantly starting at 03:06 UTC.
app-lb log line at 03:05:00Z: ERROR only 6 instances in rotation; each at 95% CPU; 503 rate climbing
diagnosis.recommended_fix: Roll back the load-balancer configuration change made overnight to restore the full set of instances into rotation, and follow up with a review of the configuration change management process.
